title: Algorithm App Window Kind Refactoring
description: Refactor semio algorithms to use elements/ui UI with AlgorithmApp and semio UI for window kinds. WindowKinds: VecInput, PiecesSelectionInput (Diagram with piece selection, no diff), DesignDiffOutput (Diagram with diff, no selection), DesignOutput (Diagram with no diff, no selection). Remove DESIGN_INPUT. Update all algorithm stories (Drag, Delete, Move, Flatten, Cluster) to use the correct window kinds.
summary: Refactored semio algorithms to use the real AlgorithmApp from @semio/ui with standardized window kinds (VecInput, PiecesSelectionInput, DesignDiffOutput, DesignOutput). Removed DESIGN_INPUT from WindowKind enum. Replaced standalone lightweight AlgorithmApp in algorithms/index.ts with re-exports from @semio/ui. Fixed elements/ui/index.tsx mega-file by removing ~7000 lines of inline stories and configs (duplicate of separate files), cleaned up ~40 unused imports. Fixed @elements/ui/elements.tsx references across storybook configs and tsconfigs (file was renamed to index.tsx). Fixed withLevel.tsx imports in both elements/ui and algorithms storybooks. Verified both algorithms storybook (10 stories) and elements/ui storybook build successfully.
